seoBody: Every sign on this page is a design we've already drawn and priced. You still pick the tube colour, the size, the backing and how it hangs, and the picture updates as you choose.

Each one is made to order in a UK workshop from silicone LED flex on cut acrylic, then boxed and sent free across mainland GB. Every sign carries a {warranty}, and you can add a dimmer and remote in the designer.
Because these designs aren't personalised, you can return one within the change-of-mind window if it isn't right for your wall. Want your own words instead? The designer prices any text in seconds.
